decision: Make predicted-pose rectangle fitting the sole perception/estimator pipeline. Require estimator integration; remove locked-heading and track-motion alternatives. Keep first-acquisition center bootstrap inside the free pose method.
validation: 32 Python behavior tests, including default full-pipeline wiring and free pose correction; four cached actual detections/native-cloud/actual MATLAB replays, independently scored. No new YOLO inference or CARLA access.
exclusions: Preserve concurrent controller, theory, manuscript and report edits; preserve past experiment artifacts as historical observations.
additionalUserDecision: The extrapolated pose is only the numerical starting value; current target LiDAR points decide the best rectangle. Removed seed-fixed support-axis selection. Symmetry support weights now depend on the current candidate and point cloud with a continuous coverage ramp, not the seed.
